hook_en: Your help comes from the LORD. 🙏
reflect_en: Armies, strength and horses all fall short, but the eyes of the LORD are on those who hope in His loving devotion. Whatever you've been leaning on this week, you can wait on Him: He is your help and your shield.
q_en: What are you waiting on God for today?
x_en: Surely the eyes of the LORD are on those who fear Him… Our soul waits for the LORD; He is our help and our shield.
tiktok: He is our help and our shield 🙏 Psalm 33:16–20 — His eyes are on those who hope in Him
yt_title: He Is Our Help and Our Shield | Psalm 33:16–20 #Shorts
li_open: Resources matter. They just can't carry the weight of hope.
li_quote: No king is saved by his vast army; no warrior is delivered by his great strength.
li_body: Budgets, staff and strategy are gifts, but the psalmist reminds us they were never meant to save us. Leaders who wait on the LORD and pray with the people they serve can plan well without carrying the weight alone, because He is our help and our shield.
reflect_es: Ni el ejército ni la fuerza pueden salvar, pero el ojo de Jehová está sobre los que esperan en Su misericordia. Si esta semana te has apoyado en tus propias fuerzas, hoy puedes esperar en Él: Él es tu ayuda y tu escudo.
x_es: He aquí, el ojo de Jehová sobre los que le temen, sobre los que esperan en su misericordia… Nuestra alma esperó a Jehová; nuestra ayuda y nuestro escudo es él.
key_en: He is our help and our shield
key_es: nuestra ayuda y nuestro escudo es él
